# KIKO App (LLM Full Context)

## 1. Purpose
KIKO provides chat + dashboard UX for token research, swap execution, wallet tracking, and strategy management.

## 2. Agent mode
Enable with either:
1) URL query: ?agent_mode=1
2) Settings -> Automation -> For Agent Mode

When enabled, the app exposes stable machine-actionable anchors and a live coordinate map.

## 3. Runtime map
Endpoint: /agent-map.json
Global: window.__KIKO_AGENT_MAP__

Top-level shape:
- schema_version
- app: {name, version, route, agent_mode}
- viewport: {width, height, devicePixelRatio}
- actions[]: route-specific recommended actions
- nodes[]: interactive/anchored DOM nodes
- timestamp

Node fields:
- id, role, action, page, key
- text, value
- visible, disabled
- route, timestamp
- bbox: {x,y,width,height,right,bottom} viewport coordinates

## 4. Key stable IDs (non-exhaustive)
Chat:
- chat.input.textarea
- chat.action.send
- chat.settings.open
- chat.model.toggle

Welcome:
- welcome.input.textarea
- welcome.action.send

Sidebar:
- sidebar.nav.trade
- sidebar.nav.market-tokens
- sidebar.user.profile

Trade:
- trade.strategies.list
- trade.strategy.card.{strategyId}.edit
- trade.strategy.card.{strategyId}.toggle
- trade.strategy.card.{strategyId}.delete
- trade.edit.buy_amount
- trade.edit.take_profit_pct
- trade.edit.stop_loss_pct

Wallet:
- wallet.header.swap
- wallet.header.send
- wallet.header.receive
- wallet.view.assets
- wallet.view.orders

Token detail:
- token_detail.copy_address
- token_detail.trade.buy
- token_detail.trade.sell
- token_detail.ask_ai

Settings:
- settings.agent_mode.toggle

## 5. Typical UI-track sequence
1) Navigate to /trade
2) Read /agent-map.json and locate trade.strategy.card.*.edit
3) Click edit
4) Fill trade.edit.buy_amount and risk params
5) Close dialog to trigger autosave
6) Re-read /agent-map.json and validate expected values changed

## 6. API-track references (blueprint)
See Kiko.md Agent API section for endpoints such as:
- POST /agent/tx/preview
- POST /agent/tx/execute
- POST /agent/strategies

## 7. Parameter dictionary
- chainId: number (e.g., 1, 8453, 137, 900)
- address: chain-native address string
- amount: decimal string
- slippage: basis points or decimal percent depending on context

## 8. Recovery strategy
- If target node missing, re-fetch /agent-map.json after route settle.
- If node exists but not visible, trigger associated open/toggle action first.
- If action fails, fall back to route navigation + remap + retry once.
